FC Etropole is a Bulgarian football club based in Etropole, Sofia Province. Founded in 1922, they competes in the Third League, the third level of Bulgarian football league system. They play their home games at the Chavdar Stadium, which now boasts a capacity of 5,600. Their home colours are red and white.
